extraction.name: LAMBADA dataset
extraction.description: LAMBADA is a dataset to evaluate the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task. It consists of narrative passages where human subjects can guess the last word if they see the whole passage, but not if they only see the last sentence.
extraction.creator: Denis Paperno, Germán Kruszewski, Angeliki Lazaridou, Quan Ngoc Pham, Raffaella Bernardi, Sandro Pezzelle, Marco Baroni, Gemma Boleda, Raquel Fernández
extraction.publisher: University of Trento, University of Amsterdam
extraction.citeAs: Paperno et al. (2016). The LAMBADA dataset: Word prediction requiring a broad discourse context. arXiv:1606.06031.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Passages were extracted from the Book Corpus (Zhu et al., 2015), which contains 5,325 unpublished novels and 465 million words. Passages were filtered using language models and then evaluated by human subjects via CrowdFlower.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Book Corpus (Zhu et al., 2015), containing unpublished novels.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Duplicate removal and filtering out of potentially offensive material with a stop word list. Passages were filtered using a combination of four language models to exclude those where the target word had probability >= 0.00175 according to any model.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human subjects guessed the target word in three steps: (1) one subject guessed based on whole passage; if correct, (2) a second subject guessed based on whole passage; if correct, (3) up to 10 subjects guessed based on target sentence only. Passages were kept only if no subject in step 3 guessed the target word.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Step 2 was added based on a pilot study to ensure data were easy given discourse context. Subjects in step 3 were allowed 3 guesses per sentence. It was ensured that the same subject could not judge the same item in both passage and sentence conditions.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 2 (for whole passage) and up to 10 (for sentence only)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Pre-trained RNN, 4-gram model, RNN, feed-forward model (used for filtering)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The development set and training corpus are available for download. The test set will be made available at the time of a planned public competition.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Proper nouns are overrepresented (48% of target words). The dataset is skewed towards nouns and proper nouns, with verbs, adjectives, and adverbs being rare.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to narrative passages from unpublished novels. The strict filtering criteria (exact match, no synonyms) may exclude some valid items. Models cannot rely on general world knowledge or external resources due to the nature of the texts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation; intended to evaluate language models on broad-context understanding.
